About Me

Self-Taught.
Results-Driven.

I didn't wait for an opportunity — I created one. In May 2024, I started learning digital marketing entirely on my own through YouTube and hands-on practice, and turned that knowledge into a full career within a year.

My mission is simple: turn every marketing rupee into measurable growth. With data-driven strategies and creative execution, I ensure brands don't just run ads — they achieve real results across Meta, Google and organic channels.

I believe digital marketing is more than just ads — it's about combining creativity, data, and strategy to deliver impactful results for every client.
